verdict.rationale: Lovable's editor documents a preview panel beside the chat where you watch the app take shape while building. Collaborators each get a draft with its own preview, and publishing is a separate step that deploys a snapshot, so the preview is clearly available before publishing. However, the docs say users "watch" the preview; they never explicitly say you can click through or use the app inside it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preview is interactive (clicking, forms, navigation, logged-in flows), and hands-on or independent confirmation of using the preview before publish.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: you describe what you want in the chat panel on the left, and you watch your app take shape in the preview on the right
each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview
Publishing turns your Lovable project into a live web app by deploying a snapshot to a URL you can share.
